bindings.name: B11
bindings.description: Deployable ::HashRelay.CloudApi — The hosted HashRelay cloud every desktop agent connects to. Realised in M1. M2 server work is limited to what D-M2-09 decides for uninstall (endpoint delete or device-credential self-revoke API; none exists today).

configuration.hosting: Azure Container Apps, consumption plan, scale-to-zero, max one replica

bindings.name: B12
bindings.description: Deployable ::HashRelay.DesktopAgent — PROPOSED (D-M2-02, D-M2-03, D-M2-05, D-M2-07, D-M2-08). Self-contained per-user install, no root.

configuration.supportedDesktops: Ubuntu LTS and Fedora Workstation with GNOME, KDE Plasma (proposed; BDL SupportedLinuxDesktops is unresolved)
configuration.ui: StatusNotifierItem tray over D-Bus where the desktop shows one; otherwise headless with the hashrelay agent CLI; pairing through the browser device flow
configuration.distribution: hashrelay-VERSION-linux-x64.tar.gz plus signed release manifest; install.sh --user into ~/.local/share/hashrelay, symlink ~/.local/bin/hashrelay
configuration.uninstall: hashrelay agent uninstall: revoke grant, clear Secret Service items and credential file, remove autostart entry, desktop entry, symlink and install dir
configuration.diagnostics: $XDG_STATE_HOME/hashrelay/logs; hashrelay agent diagnostics --export writes a zip, secrets redacted
configuration.ci: GitHub Actions Ubuntu runner: build, tar, sign the release manifest, publish to the release channel

bindings.name: B13
bindings.description: Deployable ::HashRelay.MobileApp — Present in this environment only because environment completeness covers every owned Deployable; the mobile app is not part of M2 and nothing here changes it.

bindings.name: B14
bindings.description: Service ::HashRelay.Notifications.Delivery.DeliveryService — Realtime delivery to connected agents: hub /hubs/notifications, Hello binds the connection to the endpoint, replay of unacknowledged deliveries flagged replayed; FCM HTTP v1 push for mobile endpoints. Unchanged by M2; macOS and Linux agents use the same hub protocol.

configuration.push: FCM HTTP v1 via Services/Push/FcmPushSender.cs; credential secretLocator HashRelay:Push:Fcm:ServiceAccountJson

bindings.name: B15
bindings.description: Service ::HashRelay.Notifications.Delivery.EndpointService — Endpoint registration, unchanged by M2: the platform in Hello and POST /api/v1/endpoints is a free string (trimmed to 32 chars, lowercased; EndpointService.RegisterAsync), so macos and linux need no server change.

configuration.platforms: free string; agents send windows, macos or linux

bindings.description: Resource ::HashRelay.Notifications.Delivery.EndpointStore — Realised store, unchanged by M2.

bindings.name: B17
bindings.description: Service ::HashRelay.Notifications.EndpointAgent.AgentRuntime — PROPOSED. The shared runtime with Linux adapters.

configuration.library: src/HashRelay.Client (net10.0) for hub Hello on every (re)connect with platform=linux, ack, replay, duplicate suppression, catch-up summary; REQUIRED CLIENT WORK: shared pairing flow and credential-store interface as for macOS (D-M2-12), ack, replay, duplicate suppression, catch-up summary
configuration.notificationAdapter: org.freedesktop.Notifications over the session D-Bus (Tmds.DBus.Protocol): Notify with desktop-entry hint; approval actions only when GetCapabilities lists actions; ActionInvoked goes to OneClickApprovals or opens the review page with xdg-open; otherwise the default action opens the review page
configuration.permissionState: notification server presence and capabilities, reported in status
configuration.secretStore: NEW key-value ISecretStore over the Secret Service (DeviceVault); when unavailable, a 0600 credential file and no grant
configuration.updater: in-agent updater: signed release manifest from the release channel, artifact SHA-256 check, atomic swap of the per-user install dir

bindings.name: B18
bindings.description: Resource ::HashRelay.Notifications.EndpointAgent.DeviceVault — PROPOSED (D-M2-06). Secret Service API items (gnome-keyring, KWallet).

configuration.api: org.freedesktop.secrets over the session D-Bus, default collection
configuration.fallback: no Secret Service: device credential in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/hashrelay/credential (mode 0600), degraded custody in diagnostics, no decision grant
